records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total net revenue for the three months ended March 31, 2021 increased by $3.7 billion, or 266%, compared to the three months ended March 31, 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Subscription and services-based revenue for the three months ended March 31, 2021 increased by $261.4 million, or 88%, compared to the three months ended March 31, 2020, driven by Cash App, and to a lesser extent, Seller.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Bitcoin revenue increased by $3.2 billion, and represented 87% of the increase in total net revenue.
